cases.name: CHK-002 happy: gap_analyze no longer marks stack-layering boundary as uncovered
cases.execute: const { execFileSync } = await import('child_process'); const cli = '/Users/jek/Documents/Work/Orchestrate/packages/main/dist/cli.js'; const raw = execFileSync('node', [cli, '--root', $root, 'gap_analyze'], { cwd: $root, encoding: 'utf8', stdio: ['pipe','pipe','pipe'] }); const json = JSON.parse(raw.slice(raw.indexOf('{'))); const descs = json.gaps.filter((g) => g.type === 'uncovered_requirement').map((g) => g.description); return { stackLayeringGapGone: !descs.some((d) => d.includes('Superpowers 可以触发 workflow')) };
